## Marketing Portfolio Business Administration student at Cal Poly Pomona with a concentration in Marketing Management. This portfolio highlights my work in marketing strategy, sports marketing, brand engagement, analytics, dashboards, and campaign presentations. I am interested in building marketing campaigns that connect with real audiences through clear strategy, strong storytelling, and data-driven insights.
View Projects View Resume
### Portfolio Snapshot **Focus:** Marketing Strategy, Sports Marketing, Brand Engagement **Tools:** Quarto, R, Excel, Google Analytics, Canva **Career Interest:** Sports Marketing, Brand Strategy, Marketing Analytics **Education:** Cal Poly Pomona, Business Administration — Marketing Management
--- ## About Me I am a marketing student focused on learning how brands connect with consumers through strategy, research, content, and data. My coursework and projects have helped me build experience in campaign planning, consumer insights, marketing analytics, and professional presentation design. My goal is to pursue opportunities in marketing, especially in sports marketing, brand strategy, and data-driven marketing roles. I am continuing to build my technical and creative skills through portfolio projects, analytics work, and real-world marketing experience. --- ## Featured Skills

Marketing Strategy

Developing campaign ideas, identifying target audiences, and creating positioning strategies for brands and projects.

Brand Engagement

Understanding how brands communicate with audiences through content, messaging, and customer experience.

Marketing Analytics

Using data, dashboards, and visualizations to better understand performance, trends, and consumer behavior.

Professional Communication

Creating clear presentations, written reports, and portfolio materials for academic and professional settings.

--- ## Featured Projects

Super Soakerz Marketing Campaign

A student-led campus service project focused on promotion, customer engagement, pricing, and campaign execution.

View Project →

LA Galaxy Campaign

A sports marketing project focused on fan engagement, campaign messaging, and audience connection.

View Project →

Marketing Analytics Dashboard

A dashboard page showcasing data visualization, key metrics, and marketing performance insights.

View Dashboard →
--- ## Career Objective My career goal is to grow into a marketing role where I can combine creativity, strategy, and analytics. I am especially interested in sports marketing, brand partnerships, social media strategy, and campaign performance measurement. This portfolio was created to showcase my marketing projects, technical skills, and professional growth as I prepare for internship and entry-level marketing opportunities.
